> file: smtp-taucs.c 186d09fa1ef90fbaadb1ae15a2a46225d16ad7d3 - Sun Mar 14 11:48:29 2021 +0300

> Function: GMRFLib_factorise_sparse_matrix_TAUCS(), Line: 872, Thread: 1

I wish to receive some guidance on how to deal with this problem.

 

Thanks in advance

Mahsa,

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How to solve this problem: Fail to factorize Q. I will try to fix it
parts:
The main precision matrix is numerical singular, which should not
happen. This can f.ex happen with a singular or almost singular model.
Trying to make the model more strict (ie more strict priors) usually
helps.
